verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI advertises strong data-insight capabilities: querying/editing large codebases, automated PR reviews with contextual feedback, issue triage via content analysis, and grounding via Search (gemini-cli-gh-1,10,11,7). Some users confirm value, praising code review quality and huge context window for codebase understanding (gemini-cli-comm-1,12,20), but many hands-on reports describe it getting stuck in loops, ignoring context files, and being 'terrible at agentic stuff' or unreliable for codebase navigation (gemini-cli-comm-10,11,13,14,15).
